dee168f0-1d17-4771-9199-e2925a200e33.name: Alternator Basics
dee168f0-1d17-4771-9199-e2925a200e33.summary: Alternators operate on the principle of electromagnetic induction and consist of a stationary armature winding and a rotating magnetic field. The rotor acts like a flywheel and has alternating north and south magnetic poles fixed around its outer rim.

60afab1e-2561-40d7-97b8-19a3667df49e.name: Alternator Construction
60afab1e-2561-40d7-97b8-19a3667df49e.summary: The alternator consists of a stator and a rotor, with the stator having a cast-iron frame that supports the armature core, and the rotor having alternating north and south magnetic poles fixed around its outer rim.

78a5bad6-e6d2-49fa-9228-49c8d466f60f.name: Stator Construction
78a5bad6-e6d2-49fa-9228-49c8d466f60f.summary: The stator consists of a cast-iron frame that supports the armature core, which has slots on its inner periphery to house the armature conductors. The stator has several advantages, including direct high-voltage output without brushes and easier insulation for high voltages.

1c9c7975-9047-4a1c-96a4-2552f8307b91.name: Rotor Construction
1c9c7975-9047-4a1c-96a4-2552f8307b91.summary: The rotor can be either salient pole type or smooth cylindrical type, with each type having its own advantages and disadvantages. The salient pole type is used in low to medium-speed alternators, while the smooth cylindrical type is used in high-speed turbo-generators.

68fc934a-71b8-40cc-acf7-355d92125d9a.name: Damper Windings
68fc934a-71b8-40cc-acf7-355d92125d9a.summary: Damper windings are used to prevent hunting, provide starting torque in synchronous motors, and maintain voltage balance during unbalanced loads. They consist of copper bars placed in slots on the pole-shoes and short-circuited at both ends by copper rings.

77e097ef-f0cc-475e-96d8-06a2876f8f97.name: A.C. Armature Windings
77e097ef-f0cc-475e-96d8-06a2876f8f97.summary: A.C. armature windings can be either concentrated or distributed, with each type having its own advantages and disadvantages. Distributed windings are generally used in a.c. armature windings and have two principal advantages: they generate a voltage wave that is nearly a sine curve, and copper is evenly distributed on the armature surface.

09c9a748-6c6a-46a2-9675-06f5eb252d7b.name: Induction Motor Experiment
09c9a748-6c6a-46a2-9675-06f5eb252d7b.summary: The experiment involves studying the torque-speed curve of a three-phase induction motor and analyzing its performance under varying load conditions. The goal is to understand the relationship between torque and speed, identify key points such as starting torque and breakdown torque, and observe the effect of slip on torque production.

ab3dfd5e-bdb8-415a-9f17-e2e304a112a7.name: Induction Motor Theory
ab3dfd5e-bdb8-415a-9f17-e2e304a112a7.summary: A three-phase squirrel-cage induction motor operates on the principle of electromagnetic induction, where a rotating magnetic field induces an electromotive force in the rotor conductors, resulting in the flow of current and production of torque. The motor's performance is influenced by the concept of slip, which is essential for torque production.

2036c74d-0ded-44b4-8480-405457c8cde7.name: Torque-Speed Characteristic Curve
2036c74d-0ded-44b4-8480-405457c8cde7.summary: The torque-speed characteristic curve of an induction motor demonstrates a nonlinear relationship between torque and speed, with key points including starting torque, breakdown torque, and operating region. The curve is influenced by the concept of slip and is crucial for understanding the motor's performance and efficiency.

1d320a27-b5f0-46ab-aa43-c1ee24077eb7.name: Alternators
1d320a27-b5f0-46ab-aa43-c1ee24077eb7.summary: Alternators are a type of electrical machine that generates alternating current (AC) using the principles of electromagnetic induction. They consist of a stationary armature winding and a rotating magnetic field.

c720e334-7afd-444a-a67b-e77272fd6a92.name: Alternator Construction
c720e334-7afd-444a-a67b-e77272fd6a92.summary: The construction of an alternator includes a stator (stationary armature) and a rotor (rotating magnetic field), with the stator consisting of a cast-iron frame, armature core, and slots for armature conductors, and the rotor having alternating north and south magnetic poles.

7e92d929-8441-46d2-830f-3ed617893ed3.name: Stator and Rotor
7e92d929-8441-46d2-830f-3ed617893ed3.summary: The stator is the stationary part of the alternator, consisting of a cast-iron frame and armature core, while the rotor is the rotating part, consisting of a magnetic field with alternating north and south poles.

7d32b6bd-3bbf-4ff9-b11a-8f01f37f8d32.name: Damper Windings
7d32b6bd-3bbf-4ff9-b11a-8f01f37f8d32.summary: Damper windings are used to prevent hunting (small speed fluctuations) in alternators, provide starting torque in synchronous motors, and maintain voltage balance during unbalanced loads.

99038ced-3afc-4655-9688-9ff79cbff6de.name: AC Armature Windings
99038ced-3afc-4655-9688-9ff79cbff6de.summary: AC armature windings are used in alternators and can be either concentrated or distributed, with distributed windings providing a uniform magnetic field and smoother torque.

9c4c756e-c84d-44f6-a850-03365517795e.name: Alternators
9c4c756e-c84d-44f6-a850-03365517795e.summary: Alternators, also known as A.C. generators, operate on the principle of electromagnetic induction and are used to generate alternating current. They consist of a stationary armature winding and a rotating magnetic field.

1f841065-2d9a-4d58-952e-16321ee01886.name: Basic Principle of Alternators
1f841065-2d9a-4d58-952e-16321ee01886.summary: The basic principle of alternators involves the rotation of a magnetic field, which induces an electromotive force in the stationary stator conductors, resulting in the generation of alternating current.

e0d217b9-6187-4861-a991-da2e3d7c51e6.name: Construction of Alternators
e0d217b9-6187-4861-a991-da2e3d7c51e6.summary: Alternators consist of a stator and a rotor, with the stator being the stationary armature winding and the rotor being the rotating magnetic field. The construction of alternators can vary, with different types of rotors and stators.

44814f1e-a93e-487b-96ae-f7e4ce37ffb8.name: Damper Windings
44814f1e-a93e-487b-96ae-f7e4ce37ffb8.summary: Damper windings are used in alternators to prevent hunting, provide starting torque in synchronous motors, and maintain voltage balance during unbalanced loads.

807d9bca-5223-4586-ab6f-7acfea5bf0b7.summary: A.C. armature windings are used in alternators and can be either concentrated or distributed, with distributed windings being more complex but offering superior performance.

2bd21e32-3640-40e5-95b4-35b9f44d2e7f.name: Alternator Basics
2bd21e32-3640-40e5-95b4-35b9f44d2e7f.summary: This topic covers the fundamental principles and construction of alternators, including their basic principle, stator, and rotor design. It also touches on the advantages of stationary armature and the difference between alternators and DC generators.

9c5fb2fb-9280-4e7b-bebd-aa0c8526a35f.summary: This topic explores the design and characteristics of AC armature windings, including concentrated and distributed windings, and their effects on the alternator's performance.

0bc02dfa-627b-4578-9c5a-6c2a97aa6488.summary: This topic discusses the purpose and function of damper windings in an alternator, including their role in preventing hunting and maintaining voltage balance.

dc5439f4-90c0-449a-b2f9-69bb384d1959.summary: The test plan covers various test cases for checking topic duplication, merging, and connection, as well as regression tests and frontend tests. The tests aim to ensure that the system handles topic creation and updating correctly.

74526fd6-96bf-40df-93e5-0c493e131bd2.summary: The system has certain limitations and decisions on what not to build, including no graph DB migration, no server-side layout service, and no fully-streaming per-sentence extraction. 55862308-d512-4401-85ae-f7940e719889.summary: This topic covers the addition of a new field to the topic schema to store instances of a topic, allowing for provenance and merge history.

b9a397fa-2f2d-44ef-8d8d-89be6e15ca1e.name: Frontend Updates
b9a397fa-2f2d-44ef-8d8d-89be6e15ca1e.summary: This topic covers the updates to the frontend to display pulsing nodes and edges in the knowledge graph view, indicating recent changes.

09320d76-6aa3-4a44-b840-f74d07b4f640.summary: This topic discusses the optimization of worker count and upload dispatch to improve the efficiency of the topic ingestion process.

b487cc7c-54f5-44d4-9821-14b5d506e148.summary: Alternators, also known as A.C. generators, operate on the principle of electromagnetic induction and consist of a stationary armature winding and a rotating magnetic field. They are used to generate alternating current.

85796961-e10b-4859-903e-b8ae45a1272e.summary: A.C. armature windings can be either concentrated or distributed, with distributed windings being more common. They are used to generate a uniform magnetic field and a sinusoidal back-EMF, resulting in smoother torque and quieter operation.

0adb260f-f173-4f95-95ab-0018573bff83.name: Alternator Construction
0adb260f-f173-4f95-95ab-0018573bff83.summary: This topic discusses the construction of alternators, including the stator, rotor, and other components. It also covers the advantages and disadvantages of different types of alternator construction.

5af1cabc-f9b0-4279-8a57-59bdea309978.name: Damper Windings
5af1cabc-f9b0-4279-8a57-59bdea309978.summary: This topic explains the purpose and function of damper windings in alternators, including their role in preventing hunting and providing starting torque in synchronous motors.

ff899fc8-ed18-4ffd-aaff-df659a39a0f0.summary: This topic covers the design and characteristics of AC armature windings, including concentrated and distributed windings, and their advantages and disadvantages.

d30f1b69-e918-4d38-b4f6-259f3e15a4a8.name: Alternator Construction
d30f1b69-e918-4d38-b4f6-259f3e15a4a8.summary: This topic delves into the construction of alternators, including the stator and rotor components, and their respective advantages and disadvantages. The stator consists of a cast-iron frame, armature core, and slots for armature conductors, while the rotor has alternating north and south magnetic poles.

31b8e207-23b6-4020-b9b2-3becc206e8e0.name: Damper Windings
31b8e207-23b6-4020-b9b2-3becc206e8e0.summary: This topic explains the purpose and function of damper windings in alternators, including preventing hunting, providing starting torque, and maintaining voltage balance during unbalanced loads.

17bd08ee-537e-4a38-bcb9-61c4f766b5c6.name: AC Armature Windings
17bd08ee-537e-4a38-bcb9-61c4f766b5c6.summary: This topic discusses the design and characteristics of AC armature windings, including concentrated and distributed windings, and their effects on torque, vibration, and noise.

ba044855-d599-4466-bbda-dde09c3d4446.name: Topic Duplication Handling
ba044855-d599-4466-bbda-dde09c3d4446.summary: The system identifies and handles duplicate topics across multiple uploads, allowing for efficient data management and preventing data redundancy. The goal is to enhance the existing live-event pipeline to accommodate the knowledge graph updates.

8c6ebdfc-76ae-46e8-af00-cc43e14bf7db.name: Overlapping Topic Checker
8c6ebdfc-76ae-46e8-af00-cc43e14bf7db.summary: A module that checks for overlapping topics by comparing embeddings of topic names and summaries, utilizing a vector index and a large language model for arbitration in cases where the similarity score falls within a certain threshold.

18d638cc-608e-45eb-88a8-e54e4d28d7d0.name: Schema Addition for Topic Instances
18d638cc-608e-45eb-88a8-e54e4d28d7d0.summary: Adding an optional 'instances' list to the topic schema allows for the preservation of provenance when merging topics, ensuring that the source and confidence of the information are maintained.

9205a140-b2ba-47b8-81f5-3e573ffadd8d.name: Integration with Source Manager and Backlink Detector
9205a140-b2ba-47b8-81f5-3e573ffadd8d.summary: Modifying the source manager to utilize the overlapping topic checker and integrating the results into the backlink detector to enhance the accuracy of topic connections and relations.

60ca8775-97b4-4b1f-8857-dfd27ac333cc.name: Live Events and Notifications
60ca8775-97b4-4b1f-8857-dfd27ac333cc.summary: Introducing new event kinds for finer-grained live updates, including topic addition, merging, and connection addition, to provide more detailed information about changes to the knowledge graph.

695057de-8bca-4b2f-9cb2-b2abd0d5c6c6.name: Frontend Updates for Visualization
695057de-8bca-4b2f-9cb2-b2abd0d5c6c6.summary: Enhancing the knowledge graph visualization to highlight newly changed nodes and edges, providing a more dynamic and interactive user experience.

06fc3dcb-73f9-413a-832b-2619b6d82183.name: Worker Count and Upload Dispatch
06fc3dcb-73f9-413a-832b-2619b6d82183.summary: Optimizing the worker count and upload dispatch logic to improve the efficiency and scalability of the system, without introducing new agents or renaming existing components.

5fc794bd-c844-4517-a442-ee045fed9944.name: Reconciliation Mode
5fc794bd-c844-4517-a442-ee045fed9944.summary: Reconciliation mode is used in the post-ingestion sweep to receive a small cluster of node id/title/summary pairs that an embedding sweep flagged as similar across branches. The only allowed output in this mode is zero or more `add_related_topic` operations.

c7d1b577-9adc-4682-be83-50bb4ad63082.name: Duplication Checker
c7d1b577-9adc-4682-be83-50bb4ad63082.summary: The Duplication Checker (DC) is a system prompt that arbitrates borderline cases where an embedding similarity search returns one or more candidate nodes whose score is in the ambiguous middle band. It decides exactly one tag for the chunk, considering the candidates' title and summary only.

00ecd724-e712-466f-8885-029dd164c8c7.name: Data Analyzer Output
00ecd724-e712-466f-8885-029dd164c8c7.summary: The Data Analyzer (DA) output contract specifies the shape of the output, which includes emitting each reviewed chunk as soon as it's ready, with fields such as chunk_id, upload_id, sequence_index, text, confidence, and flags.

a523e781-c3ea-4125-b445-3b638da2509e.name: Source Manager Patch Proposal
a523e781-c3ea-4125-b445-3b638da2509e.summary: The Source Manager patch-proposal note describes how to turn a raw old-text/new-text diff into a short human-readable explanation for the user's approval screen using a one-line prompt.

ff0cce20-c5a2-419d-9ed2-7a499868f4b1.name: Ingestion Pipeline
ff0cce20-c5a2-419d-9ed2-7a499868f4b1.summary: The ingestion pipeline is a series of steps that process uploaded files, including parsing, analyzing, and graphing the data. It consists of several agents, each with a specific role, such as Inspector, Data Analyzer, Duplication Checker, Graph Analyzer, Backlink Generator, and Source Manager.

8bf125c8-d52b-4627-b7e2-30c91ddf9af5.name: Data Model
8bf125c8-d52b-4627-b7e2-30c91ddf9af5.summary: The data model is a hierarchical topic tree that stores the processed data, with each node representing a topic and containing instances of that topic. The tree is addressable, and each node has a unique id.

acc8dad5-c97b-4f7a-a2f8-52cf4df89f45.name: Agent Contracts
acc8dad5-c97b-4f7a-a2f8-52cf4df89f45.summary: The agents in the ingestion pipeline have specific contracts that define their roles and interactions. For example, the Duplication Checker checks for duplicate chunks, and the Graph Analyzer consumes tagged chunks and writes/merges nodes into the Secondary Memory.

bfdd5bfc-40c5-4c65-aea5-bf9b00b50f18.name: Live Ingestion Visualization
bfdd5bfc-40c5-4c65-aea5-bf9b00b50f18.summary: The live ingestion visualization is a feature that visualizes the ingestion process in real-time, showing nodes and edges being added to the graph as the data is processed.

1a6364be-47a3-4d4d-9c2b-81258021aa88.name: Correction and Patch Flow
1a6364be-47a3-4d4d-9c2b-81258021aa88.summary: The correction and patch flow is a sequence of steps that allows users to request corrections to the data, and for the system to apply patches to the data.

26873d27-8b90-45a8-9736-e2cef627d3c0.name: System Architecture
26873d27-8b90-45a8-9736-e2cef627d3c0.summary: The suggested system architecture includes a graph storage layer, vector similarity layer, parallel data analyzer workers, live channel to frontend, and frontend graph rendering. The system is designed to handle document sizes and volumes, with considerations for scalability and concurrency.

d59837b8-8520-40f3-8e4b-909a15a7c5d8.name: Changes and Additions
d59837b8-8520-40f3-8e4b-909a15a7c5d8.summary: The system has undergone several changes and additions, including the split of the Duplication Checker into its own stage, the addition of version history per node, and the explicit statement of the Graph Analyzer being single-instance per project.

d7e414c0-d2b8-48e4-bdcc-44185346f7d0.name: Open Questions
d7e414c0-d2b8-48e4-bdcc-44185346f7d0.summary: There are several open questions regarding the system, including the scale of document sizes and volumes, the budget for Large Language Models, and the need for human approval of patches.

bd3fc22b-0029-476d-a64b-5bb401fe47f1.name: Graph Analyzer System Prompt
bd3fc22b-0029-476d-a64b-5bb401fe47f1.summary: The Graph Analyzer system prompt is an incremental topic-tree patch generator that receives one analyzed chunk per call and returns one small JSON patch operation.

6285416f-e7d4-404d-bef8-19392dff77c5.name: Alternator Basics
6285416f-e7d4-404d-bef8-19392dff77c5.summary: Alternators operate on the principle of electromagnetic induction and consist of a stationary armature winding and a rotating magnetic field. They generate alternating current (AC) as the rotor turns, cutting the stator conductors and inducing an electromotive force (e.m.f.) in them.

933f14a5-b32e-436f-93de-6411859f1763.name: Alternator Construction
933f14a5-b32e-436f-93de-6411859f1763.summary: The construction of an alternator includes a stator (stationary armature) and a rotor (rotating magnetic field). The stator consists of a cast-iron frame, armature core, and slots for armature conductors, while the rotor has alternating north and south magnetic poles fixed around its outer rim.

bcd84822-9e52-41f4-9888-e9ba6f164770.name: Damper Windings
bcd84822-9e52-41f4-9888-e9ba6f164770.summary: Damper windings are copper bars placed in slots on the pole-shoes and short-circuited at both ends by copper rings. They prevent hunting (small speed fluctuations during load changes), provide starting torque in synchronous motors, and help maintain voltage balance during unbalanced loads.

35d2ab47-5254-498f-ba95-54cd4cbbb2c5.name: AC Armature Windings
35d2ab47-5254-498f-ba95-54cd4cbbb2c5.summary: AC armature windings are distributed windings that are symmetrically distributed in slots around the complete circumference of the armature. They can be concentrated or distributed, with distributed windings offering superior performance for precision applications.

c0ba10ad-d2b5-49e6-bec0-b375f69e3bac.name: Basic principle of alternators
c0ba10ad-d2b5-49e6-bec0-b375f69e3bac.summary: Explains how alternators operate on electromagnetic induction with a stationary stator armature and a rotating rotor that creates a rotating magnetic field, determining frequency by pole count and speed, and using Fleming’s Right‑hand Rule.

fa3d846e-a986-479b-b15c-89e72ce9b95a.name: Stator (stationary armature) construction
fa3d846e-a986-479b-b15c-89e72ce9b95a.summary: Describes the stator’s cast‑iron or steel frame, laminated magnetic steel core with slots for armature windings, and advantages such as high‑voltage output without brushes and better mechanical support.

fb6442bd-b8bc-4103-b1ba-4bc668cf4252.name: Rotor construction types
fb6442bd-b8bc-4103-b1ba-4bc668cf4252.summary: Compares salient‑pole rotors used in low‑to‑medium speed machines with smooth cylindrical rotors for high‑speed turbo‑generators, outlining their geometry, lamination, and performance implications.

7f3cb6d6-765d-49a0-ad46-d2e6193b458b.name: Damper windings
7f3cb6d6-765d-49a0-ad46-d2e6193b458b.summary: Details the placement of copper bars in pole‑shoe slots, their role in damping oscillations (hunting), providing starting torque in synchronous motors, and maintaining voltage balance during unbalanced loads.

8f5262e3-b3e7-47ca-b6de-2a8288cdc0ae.name: AC armature winding configurations
8f5262e3-b3e7-47ca-b6de-2a8288cdc0ae.summary: Contrasts concentrated windings, which are compact but produce trapezoidal back‑EMF, with distributed windings that yield sinusoidal back‑EMF, smoother torque, and better heat distribution, noting trade‑offs in complexity and copper usage.

6086c30c-0012-4af8-bfe3-e3fed2cbfdff.name: Distributed winding characteristics and coil pitch
6086c30c-0012-4af8-bfe3-e3fed2cbfdff.summary: Explains the benefits of symmetrically distributed windings for uniform voltage waveforms and heating, and distinguishes full‑pitch coils (180° electrical span) from fractional‑pitch coils (less than 180°) and their impact on induced EMF.

5c3c3840-bda1-46eb-86a9-39c5d1cc6e6c.name: Alternators
5c3c3840-bda1-46eb-86a9-39c5d1cc6e6c.summary: AC generators (alternators) operate on electromagnetic induction, using a stationary armature (stator) and a rotating magnetic field (rotor).

b72a1983-173a-4443-9b54-eae2c227836a.name: Alternator Basic Principle
b72a1983-173a-4443-9b54-eae2c227836a.summary: Describes how the rotating magnetic field of the rotor cuts the stationary stator conductors, inducing an e.m.f. that yields alternating current; frequency depends on pole count and rotor speed.

9e6cf7e4-1064-4d9b-9984-48bc27ae8bdf.name: Alternator Stator Construction
9e6cf7e4-1064-4d9b-9984-48bc27ae8bdf.summary: Details the stator as a cast‑iron or steel frame supporting a laminated core with slots for armature windings, providing high‑voltage output without brushes and good mechanical support.

d7f5cbd4-75db-4004-be36-43383c203071.name: Alternator Rotor Construction
d7f5cbd4-75db-4004-be36-43383c203071.summary: Explains the rotor’s role in producing the rotating magnetic field and introduces the two main rotor designs: salient‑pole and smooth‑cylindrical types.

84f5f6b1-de24-4bbd-bc73-8791ae5cf88f.name: Salient Pole Rotor
84f5f6b1-de24-4bbd-bc73-8791ae5cf88f.summary: Used in low‑to‑medium speed alternators (≤1200 RPM); features a large diameter, short axial length, laminated projecting poles, and is unsuitable for high‑speed operation due to mechanical stresses.

a1c682d4-068d-4bb4-8628-b2fb8645bad0.name: Smooth Cylindrical Rotor
a1c682d4-068d-4bb4-8628-b2fb8645bad0.summary: Employed in high‑speed turbo‑generators (≥1800 RPM); consists of a solid forged cylinder with milled slots, offering uniform air gap, low windage loss, and smoother, quieter operation.

d3eb0e1b-fec0-43f8-a6c2-257f9da67821.name: Damper Windings
d3eb0e1b-fec0-43f8-a6c2-257f9da67821.summary: Copper bars placed in pole‑shoe slots and short‑circuited at both ends; they damp rotor hunting, provide starting torque for synchronous motors, and help maintain voltage balance during unbalanced loads.

ad196176-8178-4f0f-aa90-60ce85aa027d.name: AC Armature Winding Types
ad196176-8178-4f0f-aa90-60ce85aa027d.summary: Compares concentrated and distributed windings: concentrated windings are compact but produce trapezoidal back‑EMF, while distributed windings give a sinusoidal back‑EMF, smoother torque, and better heat distribution.

4373a3a9-a90c-4306-8d09-9dea35057461.name: AC Armature Winding Pitch
4373a3a9-a90c-4306-8d09-9dea35057461.summary: Describes full‑pitch (180° electrical span) versus fractional‑pitch coils; full‑pitch coils generate maximum e.m.f., while fractional‑pitch coils have a span less than 180° and affect the induced voltage.

725e3042-ab3d-407f-b965-2909a6257610.name: Alternator Basics
725e3042-ab3d-407f-b965-2909a6257610.summary: This topic covers the fundamental principles of alternators, including their basic construction and operation. Alternators operate on the principles of electromagnetic induction, similar to DC generators, but with a stationary armature and a rotating magnetic field.

b7b07244-c714-495f-b5eb-5dbd25821a3c.name: Alternator Construction
b7b07244-c714-495f-b5eb-5dbd25821a3c.summary: This topic delves into the details of alternator construction, including the stator, rotor, and damper windings. The stator consists of a cast-iron frame, armature core, and slots for the armature conductors, while the rotor has a rotating magnetic field with alternating north and south poles.

c47223cd-10c3-4d60-b1db-1bde1db13fa5.name: AC Armature Windings
c47223cd-10c3-4d60-b1db-1bde1db13fa5.summary: This topic discusses the design and characteristics of AC armature windings, including concentrated and distributed windings. Distributed windings offer superior performance with smoother torque, quieter operation, and better heat distribution, but are more complex and copper-intensive.

9072301a-af12-4238-8de0-116071d9df35.name: Damper Windings
9072301a-af12-4238-8de0-116071d9df35.summary: This topic explains the purpose and function of damper windings in alternators, which prevent hunting, provide starting torque in synchronous motors, and help maintain voltage balance during unbalanced loads.
